 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0}
    boxes = {}
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        r0 = min(r for r, c in cells); r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0 = min(c for r, c in cells); c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
        # Each object is a rectangular frame, possibly with a pattern in its interior.
        if (all(grid[r0][c] == color for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)) and
            all(grid[r1][c] == color for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)) and
            all(grid[r][c0] == color for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)) and
            all(grid[r][c1] == color for r in range(r0, r1 + 1))):
            pat = [[grid[r][c] == color for c in range(c0 + 1, c1)]
                   for r in range(r0 + 1, r1)]
            boxes[color] = (r0, r1, c0, c1, pat)
    sources = [color for color, (_, _, _, _, pat) in boxes.items()
               if any(any(row) for row in pat)]
    if not sources:
        return out
    source = sources[0]
    sr0, sr1, sc0, sc1, pattern = boxes[source]
    bh, bw = sr1 - sr0 + 1, sc1 - sc0 + 1
    for color, (r0, r1, c0, c1, _) in boxes.items():
        if color == source:
            continue
        # Remove frames of other sizes; matching frames receive the source pattern.
        if (r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1) != (bh, bw):

        for r in range(r0+1, r1):

 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0}
    boxes = {}
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        r0, r1 = min(r for r,c in cells), max(r for r,c in cells)
        c0, c1 = min(c for r,c in cells), max(c for r,c in cells)
        if (all(grid[r0][c] == color for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and
            all(grid[r1][c] == color for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and
            all(grid[r][c0] == color for r in range(r0,r1+1)) and
            all(grid[r][c1] == color for r in range(r0,r1+1))):
            pattern = [[grid[r][c] == color for c in range(c0+1,c1)]
                       for r in range(r0+1,r1)]
            boxes[color] = (r0,r1,c0,c1,pattern)
    sources = [col for col,(_,_,_,_,p) in boxes.items() if any(any(row) for row in p)]
    if len(sources) != 1:
        return out
    source = sources[0]
    sr0,sr1,sc0,sc1,pattern = boxes[source]
    size = (sr1-sr0+1, sc1-sc0+1)
    for color,(r0,r1,c0,c1,_) in boxes.items():

        if (r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1) != size:

                for c in range(c0,c1+1): out[r][c]=0
            continue
        for r in range(r0+1,r1):
            for c in range(c0+1,c1): out[r][c]=color if pattern[r-r0-1][c-c0-1] else 0
    return out
